fieldGuide.cost: money figure shown on the card
fieldGuide.found: the finding as [text, sourceNumber] pairs; sourceNumber links to sources[].n
fieldGuide.draftedAt: when the agent made the problem's draft or finding, like "0d 06:08": what Approvals sorts by
fieldGuide.draft: the change the agent asks you to approve (a finding has none: its suggestion is `next`)
fieldGuide.draft.money / draft.customer: sensitive: card shows Review, never one-tap Approve
fieldGuide.draft.rev: reversible: Undo stays after approval; otherwise 10 s hold then final
fieldGuide.draft.approver / draft.ask: usual approver note and the ask-them action
fieldGuide.draft.memory: team-memory note shown on the draft
fieldGuide.done: Run: what your Inhouse agent did by itself (present = handled in Run), as { text, times }: each {key:time} or {key:weekday} in text is times[key], a sample time like "0d 06:04"; times.at is when it did it
fieldGuide.partial: Run: your Inhouse agent did part (done) and the rest waits (wait)
fieldGuide.draft.runTitle / runLines / doneNote: Run version of a partial draft (doneNote as { text, times }, like done)
fieldGuide.runDoneText: confirmation text in Run for a partial draft
fieldGuide.facts: up to 3 facts for the review panel's strip: label, value, note, source (a sources[].n), tone "bad" for the bad news; shortLabel and shortNote are the phone's wording
fieldGuide.draft.kind / summary: what the draft is ("Slack post") and one sentence for the Today card's draft sheet
fieldGuide.draft.amount: the money approving it moves: { money, direction: spend | claim }, shown as "Spends $9,600" or "Claims $1,240"
fieldGuide.draft.destination / to: a short name for where it goes (the panel's progress line), and who the document goes to (its From and To)
fieldGuide.draft.items: a draft with several lines, as { name, qty, each }: the panel draws them as a table
